State the exact coefficient and background ansatz for each row.  Reconcile the literal +F_X Level-3 convention with the corrected -2F_X Level-3b result and the out-of-order minimal real-Weyl-connection theorem.  Prove which union of tested families is exhausted and list the first genuinely untested mechanisms.  If Level-3b passes, activate its causal/charge/pairing completion and do not call the minimal ladder empty.  If it fails, certify only the declared minimal-family no-go and identify the smallest representation-level escape, without claiming all compensator or scalar-tensor theories excluded.
